Q: Thnaks for taking the time to speak with me today. This recorded statement concerns the collision at the
intersection in Pearland. Can you state your full name for the record?
A: I'd rather just give you my first name for now, I'm still pretty foggy.
Q: That's fine. Do you understand this call is being recorded and that you can take a break at any time?
A: Yes, I understand.
Q: Can you describe what you were doing right before the collision?
A: I was driving through the intersection on the green light, heading toward the store. I'd just gotten past the crosswalk
when a pickup came from my right side and didn't stop for its red.
Q: Where did the impact occur on your vehicle?
A: On the driver's side, behind the door. I felt the whole car shove sideways and my head snapped against the
window.
Q: Were you wearing your seatbelt?
A: Yes, the belt locked up and I think that's what kept me from going further.
Q: Did you lose consciousness or hit your head on anything else?
A: I don't think I passed out, but I've had a bad headache since, I get dizzy when I stand up, and the light bothers my
eyes.
Q: Have you sought medical attention since the collision?
A: An ambulance took me to the emergency room. They said I have a concussion and told me to limit screen time and
rest.
Q: Is there anything you would like to add or correct in your account?
A: Only that I was not on my phone and I was going the speed limit. That's really all I remember clearly right now.
Q: Thank you. We will follow up once you have your medical paperwork.
A: Okay, thanks.
</page>

address of a clinic, shop, firm or court for a person.

injury. Do not list the date of a note, letter, report, visit, statement, filing or signature.
"words_before" = the words written on the page directly before that date, copied exactly, that say
it is the loss date. Examples: "Date of loss:", "Crash date:", "Date of injury:", "the collision on".
